intro: Qatar is an absolute monarchy ruled by the emir from the Al Thani family.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Emir Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani has ruled since 2013. He appoints the prime minister and ministers. The Shura Council advises on laws; all its members are appointed.

chapters.title: A go-between
text: Qatar often acts as a mediator in conflicts, including talks between Israel and Hamas and between the US and the Taliban. From 2017 to 2021 its neighbours blockaded it in a diplomatic dispute.

keyTerms.meaning: Someone who helps two sides reach agreement.
